EPOCHS=3000 (train_rqvae.py:82), BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK=1024 (:83), LR=1e-3 (:84), SEED=42 (:100), SINGLE_GPU_ENV="GENREC_SINGLE_GPU" (:79); the file delegates torchrun, port and workdir to the framework at :623 (stage2_launcher.launch(..., port=stage2_contract.STAGE2_PORT, world_size=4)) and returns early when RANK>=0 or the single-GPU env is "1". No CLI flags, no self-fork. The stale _LAUNCHER["master_port"]=50202 is unused metadata only.

Check 2 (paths / cost / interfaces): NEEDS_FIX (blocking).
- BLOCKING defect A: model/model.py:45-49 get_indices() calls self.encoder then self.rq with NO scale_by_radius, so the export/eval SIDs (train_rqvae.py:523 and the final item_sids.json export) quantize the raw encoder output instead of t_i = r_i*z/|z|. squash() (model/behaviour_radius.py:71) clamps |v|>0.9 then applies tanh, so every item with |z|>=0.9 maps to the identical norm 0.7163: the level-1 score loses the behaviour radius entirely and the exported SID (the artifact Stage3 reads) is not the code the model trained with. Repro: forward(x, radius=r) vs get_indices(x) on the same x give different level-1 tokens. Fix: thread radius into get_indices and pass radii[arange] at both call sites.
- BLOCKING defect B: model/layers.py:84 sets self.embed.weight.requires_grad_(False) because _tokenizer_config sets frechet_codebook=True (train_rqvae.py:262). The only other codebook estimator is the Frechet step, and its remember() call sits in the "curved" branch that the radial early-return at model/layers.py:156 makes unreachable, so frechet_step_sums() is empty and train_rqvae.py:531 "if sums:" skips the step. The codebook is frozen at KMeans init for all 3000 epochs and the loss term |sg(t)-t_hat|^2 is a dead term. Repro: after one optimizer step the codebook tensor is bitwise unchanged and .grad is None. Fix: build with frechet_codebook=False (the proposal says "no Frechet update") or leave requires_grad on.
- PASS on root marker (train_rqvae.py:42-63 requires stage2_RQ-VAE + results + stage1_GeneEmbedding, no parents[N], no absolute paths; RESULT_DIR is the promoted arm dir), on cost at frozen scale (batched [1024,256] kernel per level, no per-slot Python loop or device sync; the transition statistics are built once outside the epoch loop), and on interfaces (RQVAE.forward(embeddings,item_ids,radius), RQLayer/VQLayer.forward(x,infer_use_sk,item_ids) each have one caller shape; model/__init__.py exports intact).

Cross-area note (minor): the inherited FrechetCodebook machinery and the last-level Sinkhorn (model/layers.py:341) contradict the proposal's "no Sinkhorn, no Frechet update"; level 3 assigns by argmax of a Sinkhorn over the radial cost instead of argmin.
